title: COSAC: Counterfactual Credit Assignment in Sequential Cooperative Teams
abstract: arXiv:2604.17693v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In cooperative teams where agents act in a fixed order and share a single team-level reward (multi-agent language systems, sequential robotic tasks), per-agent credit assignment is under-determined. Critic-based approaches scale poorly as the number of agents grows owing to the costly maintenance of joint/factored critic(s), whereas the existing critic-free alternatives have other issues: common credit across agents that couples every agent's signal to teammate noise, importance-sampling corrections for upstream-update staleness that incur variance exponential in team size, or per-agent counterfactual replay that isolates each agent's effect at the price of extra environment or reward calls. We propose COSAC, a critic-free policy gradient framework for sequential cooperative teams. translated_title: COSAC：序列协作团队中的反事实信用分配
translated_abstract: 在智能体按固定顺序行动并共享单一团队级奖励的协作团队中（如多智能体语言系统、序列机器人任务），针对每个智能体的信用分配问题是欠定的。基于评论家（critic）的方法随着智能体数量增长而扩展性较差，原因在于维护联合/分解评论家的代价高昂；而现有的无评论家替代方案存在其他问题：跨智能体的共同信用使每个智能体的信号与队友噪声相耦合，为解决上游更新陈旧性而采用的重要性采样修正会带来随团队规模呈指数级增长的方差，或者需要对每个智能体进行反事实重放，虽能隔离各智能体的效应，但代价是需要额外的环境或奖励调用。我们提出COSAC，一个面向序列协作团队的无评论家策略梯度框架。COSAC通过对回放批次进行单次岭回归，拟合团队奖励的可加性逐智能体分解（为每个智能体提供学习信号……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: COSAC是一种面向序列协作多智能体团队的无评论家策略梯度框架，仅通过在回放数据上进行单次岭回归来拟合团队奖励的可加性逐智能体分解，从而高效实现反事实信用分配，避免了联合评论家的高昂维护成本、队友噪声耦合以及重要性采样带来的指数级方差问题。
en_tdlr: COSAC is a critic-free policy gradient framework for sequential cooperative teams that fits an additive per-agent decomposition of the team reward via a single ridge regression on the rollout batch, enabling efficient counterfactual credit assignment without costly joint critics, teammate-noise coupling, or exponentially high-variance importance sampling.
